class Parts(string first, string second, bool separated)

Parts partition(string text, string separator)
    length := int(#separator)
    for: index <= int(#text) - length
        if text[index:<index + length] == separator
            return Parts(text[0:<index], text[index + length:], true)
    return Parts(text, "", false)

bool contains(string[] values, string text)
    for value := values[]
        if value == text
            return true
    return false

bool only(string text, string characters)
    if #text == 0
        return false
    for: index < int(#text)
        if not characters.contains(text[index])
            return false
    return true

bool body_kind(string kind)
    return contains(["paragraph", "item", "enum", "quote", "term"], kind)

bool dictionary_word(string word)
    return only(word, "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz-") and word[0] != "-" and word[#word - 1] != "-" and not word.contains("--")

bool valid_argument(string name, string argument)
    if name == "width" or name == "indent" or name == "page"
        if #argument > 9 or not only(argument, "0123456789")
            return false
        value := int(argument)
        return if name == "width" then value >= 20 and value <= 80 elif name == "indent" then value <= 8 else value >= 10 and value <= 100
    if name == "align"
        return contains(["left", "right", "center", "justify"], argument)
    if name == "header" or name == "footer"
        return #argument.split("|") == 3
    if contains(["newpage", "verbatim", "toc", "lot", "index", "bibliography"], name)
        return argument == ""
    if name == "hyphenation"
        for word := argument.split(" ")[]
            if not dictionary_word(word)
                return false
        return true
    if name == "bib"
        parts := partition(argument, " ")
        fields := parts.second.split("|")
        return parts.separated and only(parts.first, "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789") and #fields == 3 and fields[0] != "" and fields[2] != "" and #fields[1] == 4 and only(fields[1], "0123456789")
    if name == "term"
        parts := partition(argument, "|")
        return parts.separated and parts.first != "" and parts.second != ""
    if name == "table"
        return only(partition(argument, " ").first, "lrc")
    return argument != ""

class SourceLine(int line, string text)
class Warning(int line, string message)
class Bibliography(int line, string key, string author, string year, string title)
    cited := false
    base := ""
    label := ""

class Block(string kind, int line, string argument, bool page_break, int width, int indent, string align)
    SourceLine[] body_lines := []
    SourceLine[] inner_lines := []
    term := ""
    columns := ""
    caption := ""
    text := ""
    label := ""
    number := ""
    item_number := 0
    paragraph_number := 0
    string[][] rows := []
    string[] table_lines := []

class Document()
    Block[] blocks := []
    Warning[] warnings := []
    height := 40
    page_width := 60
    header := ["", "", ""]
    footer := ["", "", ""]
    string[] hyphenation_words := []
    Bibliography[] bibliography := []

Document parse(string[] lines)
    document := Document()
    width := 60
    indent := 0
    align := "left"
    string[] accepted := []
    open_body := -1
    inner_block := -1
    pending := false
    setting_names := ["width", "indent", "align"]
    preamble_names := ["page", "header", "footer"]
    block_names := ["title", "author", "h1", "h2", "item", "enum", "quote", "term", "table", "verbatim", "toc", "lot", "index", "bibliography"]
    for: offset < int(#lines)
        number := offset + 1
        line := lines[offset]
        if inner_block >= 0
            if line == ".end"
                inner_block = -1
            else
                document.blocks[inner_block].inner_lines = document.blocks[inner_block].inner_lines.append(SourceLine(number, line))
            continue
        if line == ""
            open_body = -1
            continue
        if not line.starts_with(".")
            if open_body < 0
                if #document.blocks == 0
                    document.page_width = width
                open_body = int(#document.blocks)
                document.blocks = document.blocks.append(Block("paragraph", number, "", pending, width, indent, align))
                pending = false
            document.blocks[open_body].body_lines = document.blocks[open_body].body_lines.append(SourceLine(number, line))
            continue
        open_body = -1
        directive := partition(line[1:], " ")
        name := directive.first
        argument := directive.second
        warning := ""
        setting := contains(setting_names, name)
        preamble := contains(preamble_names, name)
        block_kind := contains(block_names, name)
        if not (setting or preamble or block_kind or contains(["newpage", "hyphenation", "bib"], name))
            warning = "unknown directive .{name}"
        elif not valid_argument(name, argument)
            warning = "bad argument for .{name}"
        elif preamble and #document.blocks > 0
            warning = ".{name} ignored after the preamble"
        elif preamble and contains(accepted, name)
            warning = "duplicate .{name}"
        if warning != ""
            document.warnings = document.warnings.append(Warning(number, warning))
        elif setting
            if name == "width"
                width = int(argument)
            elif name == "indent"
                indent = int(argument)
            else
                align = argument
        elif preamble
            accepted = accepted.append(name)
            if name == "page"
                document.height = int(argument)
            elif name == "header"
                document.header = argument.split("|")
            else
                document.footer = argument.split("|")
        elif name == "newpage"
            pending = true
        elif name == "hyphenation"
            document.hyphenation_words = document.hyphenation_words.concat(argument.split(" "))
        elif name == "bib"
            parts := partition(argument, " ")
            fields := parts.second.split("|")
            document.bibliography = document.bibliography.append(Bibliography(number, parts.first, fields[0], fields[1], fields[2]))
        else
            if #document.blocks == 0
                document.page_width = width
            block := Block(name, number, argument, pending, width, indent, align)
            pending = false
            index := int(#document.blocks)
            if name == "item" or name == "enum" or name == "quote"
                block.body_lines = [SourceLine(number, argument)]
                open_body = index
            elif name == "term"
                parts := partition(argument, "|")
                block.term = parts.first
                block.body_lines = [SourceLine(number, parts.second)]
                open_body = index
            elif name == "table"
                parts := partition(argument, " ")
                block.columns = parts.first
                block.caption = parts.second
                inner_block = index
            elif name == "verbatim"
                inner_block = index
            document.blocks = document.blocks.append(block)
    if inner_block >= 0
        block := document.blocks[inner_block]
        document.warnings = document.warnings.append(Warning(block.line, "unterminated {block.kind}"))
    return document

bool is_letter(string character)
    return "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(character)

string lower(string text)
    upper_letters := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    lower_letters := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    result := ""
    for: index < int(#text)
        character := text[index]
        for: letter < 26
            if character == upper_letters[letter]
                character = lower_letters[letter]
                break
        result += character
    return result

string upper(string text)
    upper_letters := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    lower_letters := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    result := ""
    for: index < int(#text)
        character := text[index]
        for: letter < 26
            if character == lower_letters[letter]
                character = upper_letters[letter]
                break
        result += character
    return result

class Point(int position, bool append_hyphen)

class Dictionary(int left_min, int right_min)
    string[] words := []
    int[][] points := []

    void .register(string spelling)
        parts := spelling.split("-")
        position := 0
        int[] splits := []
        for: index < int(#parts) - 1
            position += int(#parts[index])
            splits = splits.append(position)
        word := parts.join("")
        selected := -1
        for: index < int(#words)
            if words[index] == word
                selected = index
        if selected < 0
            words = words.append(word)
            points = points.append(splits)
        else
            points[selected] = splits

    Point[] split_points(string word)
        first := 0
        last := int(#word)
        while first < last and not is_letter(word[first])
            first += 1
        while last > first and not is_letter(word[last - 1])
            last -= 1
        core := word[first:<last]
        letters := #core > 0
        for: index < int(#core)
            letters = letters and is_letter(core[index])
        found := array(#word + 1, fill = false)
        appended := array(#word + 1, fill = false)
        if letters
            lowered := lower(core)
            for: index < int(#words)
                if words[index] == lowered
                    for position := points[index][]
                        if position >= left_min and int(#core) - position >= right_min
                            found[first + position] = true
                            appended[first + position] = true
        for: 1 <= index < int(#word) - 1
            if word[index] == "-" and is_letter(word[index - 1]) and is_letter(word[index + 1])
                found[index + 1] = true
                appended[index + 1] = false
        Point[] result := []
        for: 1 <= index < int(#word)
            if found[index]
                result = result.append(Point(index, appended[index]))
        return result

class Costs(int line_penalty, int hyphen_penalty, int double_hyphen_demerit, int final_hyphen_demerit, int fitness_demerit, int overfull_penalty)

class Input(int[] starts, int[] ends, bool[] midword, int first_capacity, int later_capacity)
    finish := int(#starts) - 1

    int slack(int start, int end)
        capacity := if start == 0 then first_capacity else later_capacity
        return capacity - (ends[end] - starts[start])

int line_class(int slack, bool last)
    return if last then 1 elif slack <= 1 then 0 elif slack <= 3 then 1 elif slack <= 6 then 2 else 3

int line_cost(Input metrics, int start, int end, int previous_class, Costs costs)
    slack := metrics.slack(start, end)
    last := end == metrics.finish
    current_class := line_class(slack, last)
    cost := costs.line_penalty
    if slack < 0
        cost += costs.overfull_penalty
    elif not last
        cost += slack * slack
    if metrics.midword[end]
        cost += costs.hyphen_penalty
        if metrics.midword[start]
            cost += costs.double_hyphen_demerit
    if last and metrics.midword[start]
        cost += costs.final_hyphen_demerit
    difference := current_class - previous_class
    if difference >= 2 or difference <= -2
        cost += costs.fitness_demerit
    return cost

class Breaking(int[] positions, int cost)

Breaking break_text(Input metrics, string method, Costs costs)
    int[] positions := []
    if method == "greedy"
        start := 0
        previous_class := 1
        cost := 0
        while start < metrics.finish
            chosen := start + 1
            if metrics.slack(start, chosen) >= 0
                for: chosen + 1 <= end <= metrics.finish
                    if metrics.slack(start, end) < 0
                        break
                    chosen = end
            cost += line_cost(metrics, start, chosen, previous_class, costs)
            previous_class = line_class(metrics.slack(start, chosen), chosen == metrics.finish)
            positions = positions.append(chosen)
            start = chosen
        return Breaking(positions, cost)
    int[][] totals := array(nat(metrics.finish + 1), fill = array(4, fill = -1))
    int[][] previous := array(nat(metrics.finish + 1), fill = array(4, fill = -1))
    int[][] classes := array(nat(metrics.finish + 1), fill = array(4, fill = -1))
    totals[0][1] = 0
    for: 1 <= end <= metrics.finish
        for: offset < end
            start := end - 1 - offset
            slack := metrics.slack(start, end)
            if slack < 0 and end != start + 1
                break
            current_class := line_class(slack, end == metrics.finish)
            for: previous_class < 4
                if totals[start][previous_class] < 0
                    continue
                cost := totals[start][previous_class] + line_cost(metrics, start, end, previous_class, costs)
                best := totals[end][current_class]
                if best < 0 or cost < best or (cost == best and (start < previous[end][current_class] or (start == previous[end][current_class] and previous_class < classes[end][current_class])))
                    totals[end][current_class] = cost
                    previous[end][current_class] = start
                    classes[end][current_class] = previous_class
    position := metrics.finish
    current_class := 1
    cost := totals[position][current_class]
    while position > 0
        positions = positions.append(position)
        before := previous[position][current_class]
        current_class = classes[position][current_class]
        position = before
    return Breaking(positions[::-1], cost)

import parser = "./document_parser.qui"
import hyphenation = "./hyphenation.qui"
import breaker = "./line_breaker.qui"
import renderer = "./renderer.qui"

string[] read_lines(string path)
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := content.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<int(#lines) - 1]

string[] words_in(string text)
    return [for word := text.split(" ")[] if word != "" then word]

int find_name(string[] names, string name)
    for: index < int(#names)
        if names[index] == name
            return index
    return -1

bool string_less(string first, string second)
    if first == second
        return false
    ordered := [first, second].sorted()
    return ordered[0] == first

bool tuple_less(string[] first, string[] second)
    for: index < int(#first)
        if first[index] != second[index]
            return string_less(first[index], second[index])
    return false

parser.Parts split_label(string text)
    selected := -1
    for: index <= int(#text) - 3
        if text[index:<index + 3] == " {{#"
            selected = index
    if selected >= 0 and text.ends_with("}}")
        return parser.Parts(text[0:<selected], text[selected + 3:<int(#text) - 1], true)
    return parser.Parts(text, "", false)

string pad_right(string text, int width)
    return text + " " * nat(if int(#text) < width then width - int(#text) else 0)

class BreakPosition(int start_word, int start_position, int end_word, int end_position, bool midword, bool append_hyphen)
class Span(int word, int first, int last)
class Measured(string[] pieces, Span[] ranges, int slack, bool last, bool midword)

class Metrics(string[] words, int first_capacity, int later_capacity, hyphenation.Dictionary dictionary)
    int[] offsets := []
    breaks := [BreakPosition(0, 0, 0, 0, false, false)]
    local offset := 0
    for: index < int(#words)
        offsets = offsets.append(offset)
        offset += int(#words[index]) + 1
        for point := dictionary.split_points(words[index])[]
            breaks = breaks.append(BreakPosition(index, point.position, index, point.position, true, point.append_hyphen))
        breaks = breaks.append(BreakPosition(index + 1, 0, index, int(#words[index]), false, false))
    offsets = offsets.append(offset)
    finish := int(#breaks) - 1

    int capacity(int start)
        return if start == 0 then first_capacity else later_capacity

    int length(int start, int end)
        first := breaks[start]
        last := breaks[end]
        return offsets[last.end_word] + last.end_position - offsets[first.start_word] - first.start_position + (if last.append_hyphen then 1 else 0)

    Measured measure(int start, int end)
        first := breaks[start]
        last := breaks[end]
        string[] pieces := []
        Span[] ranges := []
        for: first.start_word <= int word <= last.end_word
            left := if word == first.start_word then first.start_position else 0
            right := if word == last.end_word then last.end_position else int(#words[word])
            pieces = pieces.append(words[word][left:<right])
            ranges = ranges.append(Span(word, left, right))
        if last.append_hyphen
            pieces[-1] += "-"
        return Measured(pieces, ranges, capacity(start) - length(start, end), end == finish, last.midword)

    breaker.Input input()
        int[] starts := []
        int[] ends := []
        bool[] midword := []
        for point := breaks[]
            starts = starts.append(offsets[point.start_word] + point.start_position)
            ends = ends.append(offsets[point.end_word] + point.end_position + (if point.append_hyphen then 1 else 0))
            midword = midword.append(point.midword)
        return breaker.Input(starts, ends, midword, first_capacity, later_capacity)

Metrics make_metrics(string[] words, int[] capacities, string[] dictionary_words, int[][] dictionary_points, int left_min, int right_min)
    dictionary := hyphenation.Dictionary(left_min, right_min)
    dictionary.words = dictionary_words
    dictionary.points = dictionary_points
    return Metrics(words, capacities[0], capacities[1], dictionary)

class Token(string kind, text := "", number := -1)
class Mark(int offset, string kind, int number)
class WordMark(int word, int position, string kind, int number)
class Expanded(string[] words, WordMark[] marks)
class TextResult(renderer.page.Line[] lines, Measured[] broken, int cost)
class IndexEntry(string name, parent := -1)
    int[] marks := []
    string[] references := []
class WarningText(string name, TextResult text, bool justify)

class Result(string method, TextResult[] footnotes, local int blocks, local int indexes, local int labels)
    bodies := array(nat(blocks), fill = TextResult([], [], 0))
    WarningText[] warning_texts := []
    int[] generated := []
    renderer.page.Page[] pages := []
    front_matter := 0
    block_pages := array(nat(blocks), fill = -1)
    mark_pages := array(nat(indexes), fill = -1)
    label_values := array(nat(labels), fill = "??")

class Typesetter(parser.Document document, breaker.Costs costs, int orphan_lines, int widow_lines, int underfull_slack, int underfull_page, hyphenation.Dictionary dictionary)
    parser.Block[] blocks := document.blocks
    parser.Warning[] warnings := document.warnings
    string[] labels := []
    int[] label_blocks := []
    parser.Bibliography[] bibliography := []
    int[] cited_entries := []
    int[] body_blocks := []
    int[] headings := []
    int[] numbered_tables := []
    string[] footnotes := []
    string[] index_marks := []
    IndexEntry[] index_entries := []
    Token[][] tokens := array(#blocks, fill = [])

    void .warn(int line, string message)
        warnings = warnings.append(parser.Warning(line, message))

    int bibliography_index(string key)
        for: index < int(#bibliography)
            if bibliography[index].key == key
                return index
        return -1

    void .register_document()
        chapter := 0
        section := 0
        table_number := 0
        for: index < int(#blocks)
            block := blocks[index]
            kind := block.kind
            if kind == "h1" or kind == "h2"
                parts := split_label(block.argument)
                block.text = parts.first
                block.label = parts.second
                if kind == "h1"
                    chapter += 1
                    section = 0
                    block.number = "{chapter}"
                    if index > 0
                        block.page_break = true
                else
                    section += 1
                    block.number = "{chapter}.{section}"
                headings = headings.append(index)
            elif kind == "enum"
                block.item_number = if index > 0 and blocks[index - 1].kind == "enum" then blocks[index - 1].item_number + 1 else 1
                block.number = "{block.item_number}"
            elif kind == "table"
                parts := split_label(block.caption)
                block.caption = parts.first
                block.label = parts.second
                if block.caption != ""
                    table_number += 1
                    block.number = "{table_number}"
                    numbered_tables = numbered_tables.append(index)
            if block.label != ""
                if find_name(labels, block.label) >= 0
                    .warn(block.line, "duplicate label {block.label}")
                    block.label = ""
                else
                    labels = labels.append(block.label)
                    label_blocks = label_blocks.append(index)
            if kind == "paragraph" and index > 0 and (blocks[index - 1].kind == "h1" or blocks[index - 1].kind == "h2")
                block.indent = 0
            if parser.body_kind(kind)
                body_blocks = body_blocks.append(index)
                block.paragraph_number = int(#body_blocks)
            blocks[index] = block
        for entry := document.bibliography[]
            if bibliography_index(entry.key) >= 0
                .warn(entry.line, "duplicate bibliography key {entry.key}")
            else
                bibliography = bibliography.append(entry)

    Token .accept_command(string name, string argument, int line)
        number := -1
        if name == "ref" or name == "page"
            if find_name(labels, argument) < 0
                .warn(line, "undefined label {argument}")
        elif name == "cite"
            for key := argument.split(",")[]
                selected := bibliography_index(key)
                if selected < 0
                    .warn(line, "undefined citation {key}")
                else
                    bibliography[selected].cited = true
        elif name == "fn"
            number = int(#footnotes)
            footnotes = footnotes.append(argument)
        elif name == "idx"
            number = int(#index_marks)
            index_marks = index_marks.append(argument)
        return Token(name, argument, number)

    Token[] .parse_body_line(string text, int line)
        Token[] result := []
        position := 0
        while position < int(#text)
            opening := position
            while opening < int(#text) and text[opening] != "{{"
                opening += 1
            if opening == int(#text)
                result = result.append(Token("", text[position:]))
                break
            if opening > position
                result = result.append(Token("", text[position:<opening]))
            closing := opening + 1
            while closing < int(#text) and text[closing] != "}}"
                closing += 1
            if closing == int(#text)
                .warn(line, "unclosed brace")
                result = result.append(Token("", text[opening:]))
                break
            content := text[opening + 1:<closing]
            parts := parser.partition(content, ":")
            if parser.contains(["ref", "page", "fn", "idx", "cite"], parts.first) and parts.separated and parts.second != ""
                result = result.append(.accept_command(parts.first, parts.second, line))
            else
                .warn(line, "bad command {{" + content + "}}")
            position = closing + 1
        return result

    void .check_document()
        for: index < int(#blocks)
            block := blocks[index]
            if block.kind == "table"
                count := int(#block.columns)
                for line := block.inner_lines[]
                    cells := [for cell := line.text.split("|")[] then cell.trim()]
                    if int(#cells) != count
                        .warn(line.line, "table row has {#cells} cells, expected {count}")
                    while int(#cells) < count
                        cells = cells.append("")
                    cells = cells[0:<count]
                    block.rows = block.rows.append(cells)
                block.table_lines = renderer.format_table(block.rows, block.columns, block.caption, block.number)
                longest := 0
                for line := block.table_lines[]
                    if int(#line) > longest
                        longest = int(#line)
                if longest > block.width
                    .warn(block.line, "table too wide by {longest - block.width}")
            elif block.kind == "verbatim"
                for line := block.inner_lines[]
                    if int(#line.text) > block.width
                        .warn(line.line, "verbatim line too long by {int(#line.text) - block.width}")
            elif parser.body_kind(block.kind)
                Token[] body_tokens := []
                for: line_index < int(#block.body_lines)
                    if line_index > 0
                        body_tokens = body_tokens.append(Token("", " "))
                    line := block.body_lines[line_index]
                    body_tokens = body_tokens.concat(.parse_body_line(line.text, line.line))
                tokens[index] = body_tokens
            blocks[index] = block
        for entry := bibliography[]
            if not entry.cited
                .warn(entry.line, "unused bibliography entry {entry.key}")

    void .assign_bibliography_labels()
        for: index < int(#bibliography)
            entry := bibliography[index]
            if not entry.cited
                continue
            surnames := entry.author.split(" and ")
            base := ""
            if #surnames == 1
                count := if #surnames[0] < 3 then int(#surnames[0]) else 3
                base = surnames[0][0:<count]
            else
                count := if #surnames >= 5 then 3 else int(#surnames)
                for: surname < count
                    base += surnames[surname][0]
                if #surnames >= 5
                    base += "+"
            entry.base = base + entry.year[2:]
            bibliography[index] = entry
            place := int(#cited_entries)
            cited_entries = cited_entries.append(index)
            while place > 0
                before := bibliography[cited_entries[place - 1]]
                if not tuple_less([entry.base, entry.author, entry.title, entry.key], [before.base, before.author, before.title, before.key])
                    break
                cited_entries[place] = cited_entries[place - 1]
                place -= 1
            cited_entries[place] = index
        index := 0
        suffixes := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
        while index < int(#cited_entries)
            end := index
            while end + 1 < int(#cited_entries) and bibliography[cited_entries[end + 1]].base == bibliography[cited_entries[index]].base
                end += 1
            for: index <= current <= end
                selected := cited_entries[current]
                bibliography[selected].label = bibliography[selected].base + (if end > index then suffixes[current - index] else "")
            index = end + 1

    void .prepare_index()
        for: number < int(#index_marks)
            parts := parser.partition(index_marks[number], "|")
            names := parser.partition(parts.first, "!")
            parent := -1
            for: index < int(#index_entries)
                if index_entries[index].parent < 0 and index_entries[index].name == names.first
                    parent = index
            if parent < 0
                parent = int(#index_entries)
                index_entries = index_entries.append(IndexEntry(names.first))
            selected := parent
            if names.separated
                selected = -1
                for: index < int(#index_entries)
                    if index_entries[index].parent == parent and index_entries[index].name == names.second
                        selected = index
                if selected < 0
                    selected = int(#index_entries)
                    index_entries = index_entries.append(IndexEntry(names.second, parent))
            if parts.separated
                if find_name(index_entries[selected].references, parts.second) < 0
                    index_entries[selected].references = index_entries[selected].references.append(parts.second)
            else
                index_entries[selected].marks = index_entries[selected].marks.append(number)

    void .initialize()
        .register_document()
        .check_document()
        .assign_bibliography_labels()
        .prepare_index()
        parser.Warning[] ordered := []
        for warning := warnings[]
            place := int(#ordered)
            ordered = ordered.append(warning)
            while place > 0 and warning.line < ordered[place - 1].line
                ordered[place] = ordered[place - 1]
                place -= 1
            ordered[place] = warning
        warnings = ordered

    string citation_text(string argument)
        string[] cited_labels := []
        undefined := false
        for key := argument.split(",")[]
            selected := bibliography_index(key)
            if selected < 0
                undefined = true
            elif find_name(cited_labels, bibliography[selected].label) < 0
                cited_labels = cited_labels.append(bibliography[selected].label)
        cited_labels = cited_labels.sorted()
        if undefined
            cited_labels = cited_labels.append("?")
        return "[" + cited_labels.join(", ") + "]"

    Expanded expand_body(int block, string[] page_values)
        expanded := ""
        Mark[] marks := []
        for token := tokens[block][]
            text := ""
            if token.kind == ""
                text = token.text
            elif token.kind == "idx"
                marks = marks.append(Mark(int(#expanded) - 1, "idx", token.number))
            elif token.kind == "fn"
                marks = marks.append(Mark(int(#expanded), "fn", token.number))
                text = "[{token.number + 1}]"
            elif token.kind == "ref"
                selected := find_name(labels, token.text)
                text = if selected < 0 then "??" else blocks[label_blocks[selected]].number
            elif token.kind == "page"
                selected := find_name(labels, token.text)
                text = if selected < 0 then "??" else page_values[selected]
            else
                text = citation_text(token.text)
            expanded += text
        string[] words := []
        int[] starts := []
        position := 0
        while position < int(#expanded)
            if expanded[position] == " "
                position += 1
                continue
            start := position
            while position < int(#expanded) and expanded[position] != " "
                position += 1
            words = words.append(expanded[start:<position])
            starts = starts.append(start)
        WordMark[] word_marks := []
        for mark := marks[]
            word := int(#starts) - 1
            while starts[word] > mark.offset
                word -= 1
            word_marks = word_marks.append(WordMark(word, mark.offset - starts[word], mark.kind, mark.number))
        return Expanded(words, word_marks)

    TextResult lay_out_text(string[] words, int[] capacities, string alignment, string[] prefixes, string method, WordMark[] marks := [])
        metrics := make_metrics(words, capacities, dictionary.words, dictionary.points, dictionary.left_min, dictionary.right_min)
        configuration := breaker.Costs(costs.line_penalty, costs.hyphen_penalty, costs.double_hyphen_demerit, costs.final_hyphen_demerit, costs.fitness_demerit, costs.overfull_penalty)
        breaking := breaker.break_text(metrics.input(), method, configuration)
        renderer.page.Line[] lines := []
        Measured[] measured_lines := []
        start := 0
        for: index < int(#breaking.positions)
            end := breaking.positions[index]
            measured := metrics.measure(start, end)
            text := renderer.display_line(measured.pieces, measured.slack, alignment, measured.last)
            line := renderer.page.Line(prefixes[if index == 0 then 0 else 1] + text)
            for span := measured.ranges[]
                for mark := marks[]
                    if mark.word == span.word and mark.position >= span.first and mark.position < span.last
                        if mark.kind == "fn"
                            line.footnotes = line.footnotes.append(mark.number)
                        else
                            line.indexes = line.indexes.append(mark.number)
            lines = lines.append(line)
            measured_lines = measured_lines.append(measured)
            start = end
        return TextResult(lines, measured_lines, breaking.cost)

    TextResult lay_out_body(int index, string[] page_values, string method)
        block := blocks[index]
        expanded := expand_body(index, page_values)
        width := block.width
        first_capacity := width
        later_capacity := width
        first_prefix := ""
        later_prefix := ""
        if block.kind == "paragraph"
            first_capacity -= block.indent
            first_prefix = " " * nat(block.indent)
        elif block.kind == "item"
            first_capacity -= 2
            later_capacity -= 2
            first_prefix = "- "
            later_prefix = "  "
        elif block.kind == "enum"
            first_capacity -= 4
            later_capacity -= 4
            first_prefix = "{block.item_number:2.}. "
            later_prefix = "    "
        elif block.kind == "quote"
            first_capacity -= 8
            later_capacity -= 8
            first_prefix = "    "
            later_prefix = "    "
        else
            first_capacity -= 12
            later_capacity -= 12
            first_prefix = if #block.term <= 10 then pad_right(block.term, 12) else " " * 12
            later_prefix = " " * 12
        result := lay_out_text(expanded.words, [first_capacity, later_capacity], block.align, [first_prefix, later_prefix], method, expanded.marks)
        if block.kind == "term" and #block.term >= 11
            term_line := [renderer.page.Line(block.term)]
            result.lines = term_line.concat(result.lines)
        return result

    TextResult[] lay_out_footnotes(string method)
        TextResult[] results := []
        for: number < int(#footnotes)
            prefix := "[{number + 1}] "
            capacity := document.page_width - int(#prefix)
            results = results.append(lay_out_text(words_in(footnotes[number]), [capacity, capacity], "left", [prefix, " " * #prefix], method))
        return results

    TextResult lay_out_reference(int index, int width, string method)
        margin := 0
        for selected := cited_entries[]
            if int(#bibliography[selected].label) + 3 > margin
                margin = int(#bibliography[selected].label) + 3
        entry := bibliography[index]
        prefix := pad_right("[{entry.label}]", margin)
        text := "{entry.author}. {entry.year}. {entry.title}"
        return lay_out_text(words_in(text), [width - margin, width - margin], "left", [prefix, " " * nat(margin)], method)

    string page_list(int[] values)
        ordered := values.sorted()
        int[] numbers := []
        for value := ordered[]
            if #numbers == 0 or numbers[-1] != value
                numbers = numbers.append(value)
        string[] parts := []
        index := 0
        while index < int(#numbers)
            end := index
            while end + 1 < int(#numbers) and numbers[end + 1] == numbers[end] + 1
                end += 1
            if end - index >= 2
                parts = parts.append("{numbers[index]}-{numbers[end]}")
            else
                for: index <= current <= end
                    parts = parts.append("{numbers[current]}")
            index = end + 1
        return parts.join(", ")

    string index_entry_line(int selected, int[] mark_pages)
        entry := index_entries[selected]
        text := (if entry.parent >= 0 then "  " else "") + entry.name
        int[] numbers := []
        for number := entry.marks[]
            if number < int(#mark_pages) and mark_pages[number] >= 0
                numbers = numbers.append(mark_pages[number])
        if #numbers > 0
            text += ", " + page_list(numbers)
        if #entry.references > 0
            text += ", see " + entry.references.sorted().join(", ")
        return text

    int[] index_order(int parent)
        int[] order := []
        for: index < int(#index_entries)
            if index_entries[index].parent != parent
                continue
            name := index_entries[index].name
            place := int(#order)
            order = order.append(index)
            while place > 0
                before := index_entries[order[place - 1]].name
                if not tuple_less([hyphenation.lower(name), name], [hyphenation.lower(before), before])
                    break
                order[place] = order[place - 1]
                place -= 1
            order[place] = index
        return order

    string[] index_lines(int[] mark_pages)
        string[] lines := []
        previous_group := ""
        parent_order := index_order(-1)
        for parent := parent_order[]
            name := index_entries[parent].name
            group := if hyphenation.is_letter(name[0]) then hyphenation.upper(name[0]) else "Symbols"
            if group != previous_group
                lines = lines.append(group)
                previous_group = group
            lines = lines.append(index_entry_line(parent, mark_pages))
            child_order := index_order(parent)
            for child := child_order[]
                lines = lines.append(index_entry_line(child, mark_pages))
        return lines

    string[] contents_lines(int index, renderer.page.Page[] pages, int[] block_pages)
        block := blocks[index]
        entries := if block.kind == "toc" then headings else numbered_tables
        string[] lines := []
        for selected := entries[]
            entry := blocks[selected]
            left := ""
            if block.kind == "toc"
                left = (if entry.kind == "h2" then "  " else "") + "{entry.number} {entry.text}"
            else
                left = "Table {entry.number}. {entry.caption}"
            number := if selected < int(#block_pages) and block_pages[selected] >= 0 then pages[block_pages[selected]].display else "??"
            dots := block.width - int(#left) - int(#number) - 2
            lines = lines.append(left + " " + "." * nat(dots) + " " + number)
        return lines

    renderer.page.Line[] text_lines(string[] texts)
        return [for text := texts[] then renderer.page.Line(text)]

    void add_layout(renderer.page.LayoutBlock[] &layout_blocks, int source, string kind, renderer.page.Line[] lines, list_mark := false, first := true)
        if first
            lines[0].anchor = source
            lines[0].chapter_start = blocks[source].kind == "h1"
        layout_blocks = layout_blocks.append(renderer.page.LayoutBlock(kind, lines, list_mark, first and blocks[source].page_break))

    renderer.page.LayoutBlock[] build_layout_blocks(string[] page_values, string method, Result &result)
        renderer.page.LayoutBlock[] layout_blocks := []
        for: index < int(#blocks)
            block := blocks[index]
            kind := block.kind
            if parser.body_kind(kind)
                body := lay_out_body(index, page_values, method)
                result.bodies[index] = body
                result.warning_texts = result.warning_texts.append(WarningText("paragraph {block.paragraph_number}", body, block.align == "justify"))
                add_layout(&layout_blocks, index, "flow", body.lines, kind == "item" or kind == "enum" or kind == "term")
            elif kind == "title" or kind == "author"
                text := if kind == "title" then hyphenation.upper(block.argument) else block.argument
                text = " " * nat((block.width - int(#text)) / 2) + text
                add_layout(&layout_blocks, index, "heading", [renderer.page.Line(text)])
            elif kind == "h1" or kind == "h2"
                text := block.number + " " + (if kind == "h1" then hyphenation.upper(block.text) else block.text)
                rule := (if kind == "h1" then "=" else "-") * #text
                add_layout(&layout_blocks, index, "heading", text_lines([text, rule]))
            elif kind == "table"
                add_layout(&layout_blocks, index, "solid", text_lines(block.table_lines))
            elif kind == "verbatim"
                add_layout(&layout_blocks, index, "flow", text_lines([for line := block.inner_lines[] then line.text]))
            elif kind == "toc" or kind == "lot" or kind == "index"
                title := if kind == "toc" then "CONTENTS" elif kind == "lot" then "TABLES" else "INDEX"
                add_layout(&layout_blocks, index, "heading", text_lines([title, "=" * #title]))
                entries := if kind == "index" then index_lines([]) else contents_lines(index, [], [])
                lines := text_lines(entries)
                for: line_index < int(#lines)
                    lines[line_index].generated_block = index
                    lines[line_index].generated_line = line_index
                add_layout(&layout_blocks, index, "flow", lines, false, false)
                result.generated = result.generated.append(index)
            else
                add_layout(&layout_blocks, index, "heading", text_lines(["REFERENCES", "=========="]))
                for selected := cited_entries[]
                    reference := lay_out_reference(selected, block.width, method)
                    result.warning_texts = result.warning_texts.append(WarningText("reference " + bibliography[selected].label, reference, false))
                    add_layout(&layout_blocks, index, "flow", reference.lines, true, false)
        return layout_blocks

    string roman(int number)
        units := ["", "i", "ii", "iii", "iv", "v", "vi", "vii", "viii", "ix"]
        return "x" * nat(number / 10) + units[number % 10]

    void number_pages(renderer.page.Page[] pages, Result &result)
        renderer.page.Page[] numbered := []
        for sheet := pages[]
            chapter_start := sheet.content[0].chapter_start
            serial := int(#numbered) + 1
            if chapter_start and serial % 2 == 0
                blank := renderer.page.Page([], [], 0, true)
                blank.blank = true
                blank.serial = serial
                numbered = numbered.append(blank)
                serial += 1
            sheet.serial = serial
            sheet.chapter_start = chapter_start
            numbered = numbered.append(sheet)
        block_pages := array(#blocks, fill = -1)
        for: index < int(#numbered)
            for line := numbered[index].content[]
                if line.anchor >= 0
                    block_pages[line.anchor] = index
        front_matter := if #headings == 0 then 0 else numbered[block_pages[headings[0]]].serial - 1
        mark_pages := array(#index_marks, fill = -1)
        for: index < int(#numbered)
            numbered[index].body_number = numbered[index].serial - front_matter
            numbered[index].display = if numbered[index].serial <= front_matter then roman(numbered[index].serial) else "{numbered[index].body_number}"
            for line := numbered[index].content[]
                for mark := line.indexes[]
                    mark_pages[mark] = numbered[index].body_number
        result.pages = numbered
        result.front_matter = front_matter
        result.block_pages = block_pages
        result.mark_pages = mark_pages
        string[] label_values := []
        for block := label_blocks[]
            label_values = label_values.append(numbered[block_pages[block]].display)
        result.label_values = label_values

    Result layout_once(string[] page_values, string method)
        notes := lay_out_footnotes(method)
        result := Result(method, notes, int(#blocks), int(#index_marks), int(#labels))
        layout_blocks := build_layout_blocks(page_values, method, &result)
        heights := [for note := notes[] then int(#note.lines)]
        pages := renderer.page.choose_pages(layout_blocks, heights, document.height, orphan_lines, widow_lines)
        number_pages(pages, &result)
        for: number < int(#notes)
            result.warning_texts = result.warning_texts.append(WarningText("footnote {number + 1}", notes[number], false))
        return result

    void assemble_pages(Result &result)
        string[][] generated_texts := array(#blocks, fill = [])
        for index := result.generated[]
            generated_texts[index] = if blocks[index].kind == "index" then index_lines(result.mark_pages) else contents_lines(index, result.pages, result.block_pages)
        chapter := ""
        section := ""
        height := document.height
        total := int(#result.pages) - result.front_matter
        for: index < int(#result.pages)
            sheet := result.pages[index]
            if sheet.blank
                sheet.header = ""
                sheet.footer = ""
                sheet.body = array(nat(height), fill = "")
                result.pages[index] = sheet
                continue
            for: line_index < int(#sheet.content)
                line := sheet.content[line_index]
                if line.generated_block >= 0
                    line.text = generated_texts[line.generated_block][line.generated_line]
                    sheet.content[line_index] = line
                if line.anchor >= 0
                    block := blocks[line.anchor]
                    if block.kind == "h1"
                        chapter = "{block.number} {block.text}"
                        section = ""
                    elif block.kind == "h2"
                        section = "{block.number} {block.text}"
            values := [sheet.display, "{total}", chapter, section]
            sheet.header = if sheet.chapter_start then "" else renderer.running_head(document.header, values, document.page_width, sheet.serial)
            sheet.footer = renderer.running_head(document.footer, values, document.page_width, sheet.serial)
            content := [for line := sheet.content[] then line.text]
            string[] notes := []
            for number := sheet.footnotes[]
                notes = notes.concat([for line := result.footnotes[number].lines[] then line.text])
            padding := height - int(#content) - int(#notes) - (if #notes > 0 then 1 else 0)
            content = content.concat(array(nat(padding), fill = ""))
            if #notes > 0
                content = content.append("----------").concat(notes)
            sheet.body = content
            result.pages[index] = sheet

    Result layout(string method)
        page_values := array(#labels, fill = "??")
        result := layout_once(page_values, method)
        changed := true
        while changed
            changed = false
            for: index < int(#labels)
                if result.label_values[index] != page_values[index]
                    changed = true
            if changed
                page_values = result.label_values
                result = layout_once(page_values, method)
        assemble_pages(&result)
        return result

    string[] layout_warnings(Result result)
        string[] messages := []
        for entry := result.warning_texts[]
            for: index < int(#entry.text.broken)
                line := entry.text.broken[index]
                if line.slack < 0
                    messages = messages.append("{entry.name} line {index + 1}: overfull by {-line.slack}")
                elif entry.justify and not line.last and line.slack >= underfull_slack
                    messages = messages.append("{entry.name} line {index + 1}: underfull, slack {line.slack}")
        for sheet := result.pages[]
            empty := document.height - sheet.height
            if not sheet.blank and not sheet.ends_by_force and empty >= underfull_page
                messages = messages.append("page {sheet.serial}: underfull, {empty} empty lines")
        hyphenated := 0
        for index := body_blocks[]
            for line := result.bodies[index].broken[]
                if line.midword
                    hyphenated += 1
        messages = messages.append("{#result.pages} pages, {hyphenated} hyphenated lines")
        return [for message := messages[] then result.method + ": " + message]

    string[] statistics(Result optimal, Result greedy)
        lines := ["paragraph,lines_kp,cost_kp,lines_greedy,cost_greedy"]
        totals := [0, 0, 0, 0]
        for index := body_blocks[]
            first := optimal.bodies[index]
            second := greedy.bodies[index]
            values := [int(#first.broken), first.cost, int(#second.broken), second.cost]
            fields := ["{blocks[index].paragraph_number}"]
            for: column < 4
                totals[column] += values[column]
                fields = fields.append("{values[column]}")
            lines = lines.append(fields.join(","))
        return lines.append("total," + [for value := totals[] then "{value}"].join(","))

class Line(string text)
    int[] footnotes := []
    int[] indexes := []
    anchor := -1
    chapter_start := false
    generated_block := -1
    generated_line := -1

class LayoutBlock(string kind, Line[] lines, bool list, bool page_break)
class Boundary(int end, int next_start, bool forced)
class Page(Line[] content, int[] footnotes, int height, bool ends_by_force)
    blank := false
    chapter_start := false
    serial := 0
    body_number := 0
    display := ""
    header := ""
    footer := ""
    string[] body := []

Page[] choose_pages(LayoutBlock[] blocks, int[] footnote_heights, int height, int orphan, int widow)
    Line[] lines := []
    Boundary[] boundaries := []
    for: index < int(#blocks)
        block := blocks[index]
        start := int(#lines)
        lines = lines.concat(block.lines)
        count := int(#block.lines)
        if block.kind == "flow"
            for: 1 <= kept < count
                if kept >= orphan and count - kept >= widow
                    boundaries = boundaries.append(Boundary(start + kept, start + kept, false))
        if index + 1 == int(#blocks)
            boundaries = boundaries.append(Boundary(int(#lines), int(#lines), true))
        else
            following := blocks[index + 1]
            end := int(#lines)
            if not (block.list and following.list)
                lines = lines.append(Line(""))
            if following.page_break or block.kind != "heading"
                boundaries = boundaries.append(Boundary(end, int(#lines), following.page_break))
    Page[] pages := []
    start := 0
    first_boundary := 0
    while start < int(#lines)
        notes := array(#footnote_heights, fill = false)
        note_height := 0
        scanned := start
        chosen := -1
        used := 0
        int[] chosen_notes := []
        for: first_boundary <= index < int(#boundaries)
            boundary := boundaries[index]
            while scanned < boundary.end
                for number := lines[scanned].footnotes[]
                    if not notes[number]
                        notes[number] = true
                        note_height += footnote_heights[number]
                scanned += 1
            int[] page_notes := []
            for: number < int(#notes)
                if notes[number]
                    page_notes = page_notes.append(number)
            current_height := boundary.end - start + note_height + (if #page_notes > 0 then 1 else 0)
            if current_height > height
                break
            chosen = index
            used = current_height
            chosen_notes = page_notes
            if boundary.forced
                break
        boundary := boundaries[chosen]
        pages = pages.append(Page(lines[start:<boundary.end], chosen_notes, used, boundary.forced))
        start = boundary.next_start
        first_boundary = chosen + 1
    return pages

string replace(string text, string pattern, string replacement)
    result := ""
    position := 0
    width := int(#pattern)
    while position < int(#text)
        if position + width <= int(#text) and text[position:<position + width] == pattern
            result += replacement
            position += width
        else
            result += text[position]
            position += 1
    return result

string trim_right(string text)
    end := int(#text)
    while end > 0 and text[end - 1] == " "
        end -= 1
    return text[0:<end]

string display_line(string[] pieces, int slack, string alignment, bool last)
    displayed := [for piece := pieces[] then replace(piece, "~", " ")]
    text := displayed.join(" ")
    if slack <= 0
        return text
    gaps := int(#displayed) - 1
    if alignment == "justify" and not last and gaps > 0
        text = displayed[0]
        for: 1 <= index < int(#displayed)
            spaces := slack / gaps + 1 + (if index - 1 < slack % gaps then 1 else 0)
            text += " " * nat(spaces) + displayed[index]
        return text
    if alignment == "right"
        return " " * nat(slack) + text
    if alignment == "center"
        return " " * nat(slack / 2) + text
    return text

string[] format_table(string[][] rows, string columns, string caption, string number)
    widths := array(#columns, fill = 0)
    for row := rows[]
        for: index < int(#columns)
            if int(#row[index]) > widths[index]
                widths[index] = int(#row[index])
    string[] lines := []
    if caption != ""
        lines = lines.append("Table {number}. {caption}")
    for: row_index < int(#rows)
        string[] cells := []
        for: index < int(#columns)
            text := rows[row_index][index]
            missing := widths[index] - int(#text)
            cell := ""
            if columns[index] == "l"
                cell = text + " " * nat(missing)
            elif columns[index] == "r"
                cell = " " * nat(missing) + text
            else
                cell = " " * nat(missing / 2) + text + " " * nat(missing - missing / 2)
            cells = cells.append(cell)
        lines = lines.append(trim_right(cells.join(" | ")))
        if row_index == 0
            rule := [for width := widths[] then "-" * nat(width)]
            lines = lines.append(rule.join("-+-"))
    return lines

string running_head(string[] fields, string[] values, int width, int serial)
    string[] expanded := []
    names := ["page", "pages", "chapter", "section"]
    for field := fields[]
        text := field
        for: index < 4
            text = replace(text, "{{" + names[index] + "}}", values[index])
        expanded = expanded.append(text)
    if serial % 2 == 0
        saved := expanded[0]
        expanded[0] = expanded[2]
        expanded[2] = saved
    line := array(nat(width), fill = " ")
    starts := [0, (width - int(#expanded[1])) / 2, width - int(#expanded[2])]
    for: index < 3
        for: position < int(#expanded[index])
            line[starts[index] + position] = expanded[index][position]
    return trim_right(line.join(""))

string[] pages_lines(page.Page[] pages)
    string[] lines := []
    for sheet := pages[]
        lines = lines.concat(["--- page {sheet.serial} ---", sheet.header, ""]).concat(sheet.body).concat(["", sheet.footer])
    return lines
